name: room
text: Room opened — goal: creators: Build PACKAGES + enrich tabs + draft elements; every one labeled 'Created by EXCAVA' + tes

name: Forge
text: I propose that we prioritize the creation of standardized templates for our packages. This decision will streamline our workflow, ensuring that each package maintains a consistent quality while also speeding up the development time for each item. The trade-off here is that we may sacrifice some unique features or customization in individual packages, but the overall efficiency and reliability will greatly enhance our output and maintain the 'Created by EXCAVA' branding.

name: Vet
text: Vet — the skeptic — leans forward: "Standardized templates sound neat, but the real risk is that we’ll bake in yesterday’s assumptions and stifle the very uniqueness we’re supposed to be enriching. Instead, let’s agree on a *minimum viable structure* for every package—just enough to ensure consistency—then let each creator adapt it to their element’s needs. That way, we keep quality without forcing everyone into a one-size-fits-all box. Settle it by testing two sample packages: one built with the template, one without, and compare the time-to-draft and feedback scores."
